hero.headline: NMIMS Online MBA in Human Resource Management: Syllabus, Fees and Career Outcomes
hero.sub: UGC-DEB approved specialisation. 15 spec subjects across Sem 3-4. NIRF University #52, Mumbai heritage brand.

sections.tldr: NMIMS Online MBA in Human Resource Management covers compensation and benefits, industrial relations, labour laws, manpower planning, recruitment and selection, organisational development, performance management, learning and development, and emotional intelligence across 15 Sem 3-4 subjects. Best for HR professionals targeting HRBP, HR head, or talent management leadership roles.

about.body:
HR professionals who complete the NMIMS Online MBA in HRM carry a degree name that corporate CHRO functions and HR leadership at BFSI, manufacturing, and professional services firms recognise.

The HRM specialisation covers the full HR management lifecycle: talent acquisition, compensation design, industrial relations and labour law compliance, manpower planning, organisational development, performance management, learning and development, and emotional intelligence for HR leadership.

This specialisation targets HR generalists and specialists with 2-5 years of experience who want to move into HRBP, HR manager, or HR head roles, and who want the NMIMS credential to support that transition. Full programme overview at /universities/nmims-online/mba.

subjects.name: Corporate Finance
subjects.description: Build financial literacy for HR leaders: understanding P&L impact of workforce costs, compensation budget management, and ROI on HR programmes.

subjects.name: Research Methodology
subjects.description: Apply HR research methods: survey design for employee engagement, HR data analysis, and hypothesis testing for workforce policy decisions.

subjects.name: Project Pre-work
subjects.description: Define dissertation scope and literature review structure for the Sem 4 HR research project under supervisor guidance.

subjects.name: Compensation & Benefits
subjects.description: Design compensation structures, salary grading systems, variable pay programmes, and benefits frameworks for Indian corporate environments.

subjects.name: Industrial Relations & Labour Laws
subjects.description: Manage union relations, collective bargaining, grievance procedures, and statutory compliance under Indian labour legislation.

subjects.name: Manpower Planning
subjects.description: Build workforce planning models: headcount forecasting, succession planning, skill gap analysis, and workforce analytics for HR strategy.

subjects.name: Recruitment & Selection
subjects.description: Design end-to-end hiring processes: job analysis, sourcing strategy, structured interview design, assessment centres, and selection decisions.

subjects.name: Organisational Development & Change
subjects.description: Lead OD interventions: change management models, culture transformation, organisational restructuring, and workforce readiness for change.

subjects.name: Indian Ethos & Ethics
subjects.description: Integrate Indian value systems, Gandhian principles, and workplace ethics into HR policy design and people management decisions.

subjects.name: Corporate Sustainability
subjects.description: Apply ESG workforce metrics, DEI programme design, and sustainable HR practices to align people strategy with corporate sustainability goals.

subjects.name: International Business
subjects.description: Manage cross-border HR: global mobility, expat compensation, international labour law frameworks, and HR strategy in multinational contexts.

subjects.name: Project
subjects.description: Complete a dissertation-grade research or consulting project applying HR Management specialisation knowledge to a real workforce problem.

subjects.name: Performance Management System
subjects.description: Design and implement performance review cycles, KRA-KPI frameworks, 360-degree feedback systems, and performance-linked pay structures.

subjects.name: Learning & Development
subjects.description: Build L&D strategy: training needs analysis, LMS implementation, leadership development programmes, and measurement of learning ROI.

subjects.name: Emotional Intelligence
subjects.description: Apply EI frameworks to HR leadership: self-awareness, empathy in employee relations, conflict resolution, and emotionally intelligent people management.

skills.body:
The NMIMS Human Resource Management specialisation builds skills that large corporate and BFSI employers test at HRBP and HR head level:

- Compensation Design: salary grading, variable pay programme design, and benefits benchmarking against market data for Total Rewards Head and compensation manager roles
- Industrial Relations: union management, standing order compliance, disciplinary inquiry procedures, and collective bargaining for manufacturing and large-scale service HR roles
- Performance Management: KRA-KPI cascading, rating calibration process, and linking performance outputs to compensation and promotion decisions across large organisations
- Manpower Planning: workforce demand forecasting, succession pipeline management, and skill gap closure strategy for HR Business Partners at growing organisations

- Organisational Development: change management methodology (Kotter, ADKAR), culture assessment tools, and OD intervention design for CHRO and HR transformation roles
- Learning and Development: training needs analysis, learning programme design, and measuring L&D ROI for corporate university and L&D Head roles

**Soft skills:** Managing the CHRO-CEO relationship, presenting HR metrics and talent dashboards to the board, and navigating industrial disputes without production disruption.

comparisons.body:
**vs Amity Online MBA HR Analytics:** Amity HR Analytics is the data-oriented HR credential, covering people analytics platforms, HRIS, and workforce intelligence. NMIMS HRM is stronger on classical HR management disciplines: compensation design, industrial relations, OD, and performance management. For analytics-focused HR careers, Amity HR Analytics is more differentiated. For generalist HR leadership roles at large corporates, NMIMS HRM provides broader coverage.

**vs Symbiosis Online MBA Human Resource Management:** Symbiosis is NAAC A++ at competitive fees with strong recognition in the Pune-Maharashtra corporate ecosystem. For manufacturing sector HR roles in Maharashtra (automotive, pharma), both Symbiosis and NMIMS are strong options. NMIMS brand has an edge in BFSI and Mumbai-headquartered large corporates. Choose based on target sector and employer geography.

certificate.body: The NMIMS (Narsee Monjee Institute of Management Studies) degree certificate carries the NMIMS name, the MBA designation, and identifies the online learning mode per UGC-DEB 2020 regulations. The Human Resource Management specialisation is noted on the marksheet and transcript. The certificate names the online mode, as UGC-DEB rules require. It counts the same as a regular MBA for jobs, promotions and further study.

faqs.question: Is SHRM or HRCI certification a better credential than this MBA for HR careers?
faqs.answer: SHRM-CP, SHRM-SCP, SPHR, and PHR are globally recognised HR certifications that demonstrate HR knowledge and competency. The NMIMS MBA is a management degree that provides broader business context alongside HR specialisation. For senior HR leadership roles at large Indian corporates, the management degree is typically required or preferred over stand-alone certifications. The combination of NMIMS MBA plus SHRM certification is a strong credentials package for HRBP and HR Head roles.

faqs.question: How is the Industrial Relations content relevant outside of manufacturing?
faqs.answer: Industrial relations and labour law knowledge is relevant beyond manufacturing. IT companies under the IT Act, BFSI firms under banking regulations, and e-commerce companies with large frontline workforces all require IR compliance. The collective bargaining, disciplinary inquiry, and labour law frameworks apply wherever there is a regulated employer-employee relationship. Even in non-union environments, the compliance framework from the Industrial Relations module applies to standing orders, retrenchment procedures, and grievance management.

faqs.question: Does this MBA cover HRIS platforms and HR analytics?
faqs.answer: The Manpower Planning module includes workforce analytics elements. However, deep HRIS platforms (Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, Darwinbox) and people analytics are not the primary focus of this specialisation. For professionals specifically targeting HR Analytics or HRIS roles, Amity Online's HR Analytics spec is more directly relevant. NMIMS HRM is stronger for generalist HR leadership roles across compensation, IR, OD, and talent management.

faqs.question: Can this MBA help HR professionals at startups transition to large corporate HR?
faqs.answer: Yes. The NMIMS brand and the formal management credential are both assets when transitioning from startup to large corporate HR. The manpower planning and OD content is particularly applicable as you move from building HR systems from scratch to managing existing HR structures at scale.
